channel.title: Technical Marketing
channel.description: A quarterly publication and working reference for the technical marketing discipline: the practice of proving technically complex claims to technically capable buyers, with a commercial outcome at stake. Each volume indexes current practitioner thinking on definition, craft, career, and method.
channel.itunes:author: Chad Corriveau

item.title: Technical Marketing in the Age of AI
item.description: AI is compressing artifact production across every GTM discipline. Technical marketing does not contract under that pressure. The argument for why the discipline expands when everything around it shrinks.
